description: Curated semantic entry points. TeX source owns current labels and numbers; see tools/manuscript_map.py.

current.label: thm:main
current.note: MainTheorem includes explicit global-solution/restriction clauses; every admissible cutoff is quantified. Final result retains the checker-acceptance hypothesis.

current.label: thm:conditional
current.note: Introductory collection of the criterion, moment defect and stationary solution; no single declaration matches this complete package.

current.label: thm:linear
